notes.note: Reviewed the final setup presentation delta: required owner code, full key ID, separate-channel acknowledgement, native tuple and expiry validation remain unchanged. The received fingerprint and route metadata move into one collapsed identity disclosure; unconfigured connections show trust confirmation before routing/device controls. Configured Station management remains available. Expired candidates explain the disabled confirmation. The guide now follows those steps. Also reviewed the four explicitly Brian-approved high advisory exceptions, unchanged residuals and protected policy hashes, and the linked seven-day attestation. Focused mounted/native-intake tests passed 81 tests. Actual Project-member acceptance and physical delivery remain NOT_VERIFIED.
